description: Ministry of Sports - Order to Convened an Election to elect new Office- bearers to Sri Lanka Archery Association for 2018/2020
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Faiszer Musthapha, Minister of Sports) and outlines detailed responsibilities and actions taken under the Sports Act, including suspending the registration of the Sri Lanka Archery Association and appointing a competent authority with specific functions. This combination of a named government official and detailed portfolio responsibilities qualifies it as a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
